options swap_delay=12 iteration=20 ignore_burst_energy=true;

xiangling char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
xiangling add weapon="thecatch" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
xiangling add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
xiangling add stats er=0.3;

xingqiu char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
xingqiu add weapon="harbingerofdawn" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
xingqiu add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
xingqiu add stats er=0.5;

bennett char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
bennett add weapon="aquilafavonia" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
bennett add set="noblesseoblige" count=4;
bennett add stats er=0.5;

yelan char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
yelan add weapon="slingshot" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
yelan add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;
yelan add stats er=0.5;

target lvl=100 resist=0.1 radius=2 pos=0,2.4 hp=999999999;

active bennett;
for let i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1 {
  bennett skill[hold=1], burst;
  xiangling skill, burst;
  xingqiu skill, burst, attack;
  yelan skill, burst;
  bennett attack:2;
  xiangling attack:3;
  xingqiu attack:3;
  yelan attack:2;
}
